app.name: Tuna
app.long_description: Browse FAT32 SD/USB /music and /tuna, preview adaptive compression, and boot a GBA over the GBA-GameCube cable. Converted files are saved to SD /tuna before transfer and reused on retries. Port 2 by default. No cartridge required. Complete tracks up to five minutes fit using low-fidelity profiles; three-minute defaults use 2-bit ADPCM at 4096 Hz. No silent cropping. A legal GBA BIOS is required for emulator multiboot acceptance.
